name: legal_terms
description: Retrieve legal roles, contract and tort elements, and procedure terms from a fixed definition table; matched non-legal definition retrieval controls.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
legal=[('a legally enforceable agreement','contract'),('a proposal to enter a contract on specified terms','offer'),('unqualified assent to the terms of an offer','acceptance'),('the bargained-for exchange of value supporting a contract','consideration'),('failure to perform a contractual obligation','breach'),('money awarded to compensate a claimant for loss','damages'),('a civil wrong other than breach of contract','tort'),('failure to exercise reasonable care','negligence'),('the legal obligation to exercise reasonable care','duty'),('the causal connection between conduct and injury','causation'),('the party who brings a civil lawsuit','plaintiff'),('the party against whom a lawsuit is brought','defendant'),('a lawyer who represents a client','attorney'),('the official who presides over a court proceeding','judge'),('the group of citizens that decides disputed facts at trial','jury'),('the formal decision returned by a jury','verdict'),('a request for a higher court to review a lower court decision','appeal'),('a law enacted by a legislature','statute'),('a court order requiring a person to testify or produce documents','subpoena'),('a court order requiring or prohibiting specified conduct','injunction'),('a written statement sworn to be true','affidavit'),('the pretrial process for exchanging relevant information','discovery'),('a prior judicial decision used as authority in a later case','precedent'),('a court\'s authority to hear and decide a case','jurisdiction'),('the geographic location where a case is tried','venue'),('a negotiated resolution ending a dispute','settlement'),('a formal request asking a court to issue an order','motion'),('a court proceeding in which evidence is presented to decide a case','trial'),('information offered to establish facts in a legal proceeding','evidence'),('a witness\'s sworn statements in court','testimony'),('the person who makes a will','testator'),('a person who holds property for the benefit of another','trustee')]
control=[('the star at the center of our solar system','sun'),('the natural satellite of Earth','moon'),('a scientist who studies living organisms','biologist'),('the organ that pumps blood','heart'),('the process by which plants use sunlight to make food','photosynthesis'),('the freezing point of water in Celsius','zero'),('a shape with three sides','triangle'),('a shape with four equal sides and four right angles','square'),('an instrument used to measure temperature','thermometer'),('an instrument used to view distant stars','telescope'),('an instrument used to magnify tiny objects','microscope'),('the largest ocean on Earth','Pacific'),('the largest planet in our solar system','Jupiter'),('the chemical element with symbol O','oxygen'),('the chemical element with symbol Fe','iron'),('a person who writes books','author'),('a person who cooks professionally','chef'),('a person who designs buildings','architect'),('an animal with a long trunk','elephant'),('a young dog','puppy'),('a young cat','kitten'),('the opposite of north','south'),('the opposite of east','west'),('the season following spring','summer'),('the season following summer','autumn'),('the number of days in a week','seven'),('the number of months in a year','twelve'),('the language traditionally spoken in France','French'),('the capital city of Japan','Tokyo'),('the currency of Japan','yen'),('the branch of mathematics concerned with shapes','geometry'),('the force that attracts objects toward Earth','gravity')]
templates=['Give the standard term for this definition: {d}.\nAnswer:','Vocabulary quiz. Definition: {d}.\nTerm:','What word means {d}?\nAnswer:']
def make(table):
 rows=[{'prompt':t.format(d=d),'answer':' '+a} for t in templates for d,a in table];random.shuffle(rows);return rows
json.dump({'items':make(legal),'control':make(control)},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
